forum.title: Error installing CubeMX 6.17.0
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @STuser2

Let's try to delete the existing stm32cube\_mx\_v6170-win.zip file and any CubeMX-related temporary or cache files, then download the installer again directly from [the official ST website](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html) using a stable connection; if possible, try a different browser or network. Also check whether antivirus, proxy, VPN, or corporate security tools are modifying the download. Once you have a clean file, verify that it extracts correctly and then run the installer as administrator.

THX

Ghofrane
